## Objective
The brand token, the wordmark, the A mark and the favicon **already ship**. The
owner-approved out-of-band UI baseline (AM-028, commit `b366be1`, an ancestor of
this card's base) created `BrandWordmark.tsx` and `BrandMark.tsx`, replaced
`web/public/favicon.svg` byte for byte, added the `--brand-mark` token and
rewired `TopBar`. This card is the reconciliation AM-028 owed P2.1
(`docs/v2/state/AMENDMENTS.md:33`, "Reconciliation owed"), and its deliverable
is coverage, not implementation: the shipped brand components get unit tests,
the top bar's shipped shape gets a test, and the favicon, the `--brand-mark`
values and the no-font-in-the-bundle rule get runnable rows — so a regression is
a failing test rather than a quiet visual change. The implementation shipped;
the tests are the deliverable.

## Fixed decisions
The shipped brand implementation is already correct and this card changes none
of it. The already-shipped behaviour these tests must pin, read off the base
commit:

- **Two of this card's original rules are retired by owner decision — the code
  wins.** (1) The top bar renders `tone="text"`, so the wordmark takes
  `var(--text-primary)`, **not** `var(--brand-mark)`; (2) the wordmark height is
  the `--logo-h` token (**20px** at base), **not** 22px. Both are the owner's
  2026-09-26 Claude-style preview decision, recorded in the sources at
  `BrandWordmark.tsx:8-12` and `:37-38`, `TopBar.tsx:19-25`, and authorised by
  AM-028. Do **not** "fix" either back to this card's original text: that is a
  revert of an owner-approved baseline, and a stop condition below.
- **`--brand-mark` is D10's pair and still governs the brand surfaces**:
  `#1f6f63` in light (`tokens.css:183`) and `#ffffff` in dark (`:332`), each
  declared exactly once, deliberately **not** derived from `--accent`. It
  colours the A mark and any future brand surface; the top bar is not one of
  them.
- **Wordmark** (`BrandWordmark.tsx`): `viewBox="0 0 2903 1012"`,
  `role="img"` with `aria-label="Apunta"` (the brand, not the file),
  `focusable="false"`, and one `<path fill="currentColor">` inlined from
  `apunta-wordmark.currentcolor.svg`. Its inline `color` is
  `var(--text-primary)` under `tone="text"` and `var(--brand-mark)` at the
  default `tone` (`'brand'`); `height` is `var(--logo-h)` unless a caller passes
  an exact number, `width` is `auto`; it never follows `--accent`.
- **A mark** (`BrandMark.tsx`): `viewBox="0 0 562 754"`, `aria-hidden="true"`
  and `focusable="false"` — decorative, because the wordmark or the page title
  already names the app — 48 px tall, `width: auto`, `display: block`,
  `margin: 0 auto` (centred in whatever block it sits in),
  `color: var(--brand-mark)`, one `<path fill="currentColor">`, and a colour
  that never resolves from `--accent`. This is the mark P2.2 places above the
  home greeting; `HomeLauncher.tsx:73` already renders it.
- **Top bar shape** (`TopBar.tsx`): with no `back` prop, exactly one wordmark
  and nothing else — no `MarkIcon`, no typed
  `<span class="brand">Apunta</span>`, no second `aria-hidden` mark; with a
  `back` prop, the `Link` plus `BackIcon` and **no** wordmark.
- **Favicon**: `web/public/favicon.svg` is byte-for-byte
  `docs/v2/assets/favicon.svg` (true at base; that is the pin).
- **No font file in the bundle**: Kalam ships as outlines only and the name is
  never typed in a font at runtime. The only fonts in `web/dist` are the six
  pre-existing Inter subsets copied from `web/public/fonts/`.
- **`MarkIcon` (`icons.tsx:25`) is dead code at base — zero importers, as the
  grep above shows.** It is the pre-brand scribble and its stroke follows
  `--accent`. **Report it; delete nothing.** Removing it is the coordinator's
  call, as a separate amendment that would add `icons.tsx` to May edit with a
  test proving nothing imported it. This card records it in the return file's
  Unresolved items and stops there.
- **The A mark does not yet have all three surfaces.**
  `docs/v2/assets/README.md` names "home greeting, About, setup"; at base only
  the home greeting renders one — `web/src/routes/About.tsx` renders none and
  `Setup.tsx:168`'s `StateMark` is an unrelated status dot. That gap is a
  finding to report, not work for this card.
- **No production change.** If honouring an assertion seems to need an edit to
  any file in Must not edit, that is a stop, not a task.

## Steps

2. Add `TopBar.test.tsx`: with no `back`, the accessible name "Apunta" resolves

   render needs a router (the `MemoryRouter` wrapper at `AiBanner.test.tsx:9-14`
   is the shape).
3. Record what each run actually printed, including a first run that passes
   unchanged: this behaviour already exists, so a pass on the base commit is the

## Stop conditions
- A new test shows the shipped behaviour does **not** match Fixed decisions — a
  missing `aria-label`, a path that is not `fill="currentColor"`, a mark that
  follows `--accent`, a `--brand-mark` hex that is not D10's: report it as a
  finding for the coordinator and **do not** change the file to make the test
  pass. Record the failing assertion, the observed value and the source line.
- Honouring a Fixed decision would change the owner-approved AM-028 treatment —
  putting `var(--brand-mark)` back in the top bar, or `--logo-h` back to 22px —
  or would give the A mark a new surface: stop and report it. Those are
  owner-visible changes to an approved baseline and need explicit owner
  authorisation (an amendment), not a card edit.
- `MarkIcon` looks like it should go, or deleting anything in `icons.tsx` seems
  necessary: stop and report. Zero importers is a finding for the coordinator,
  and this card deletes nothing (see Fixed decisions).
- The three tests pass on the base commit's behaviour: that is the expected
  result, not a missing failure. Record it and finish as a test-only change. Do
  **not** edit production code to manufacture a failure, and do not remove or
  weaken any case already in `web/src/components/*.test.tsx`.
- V1 collects no brand test file, or V3's count is not 6: `FAIL` with the command,
  the exit code and the full output — a directory filter that silently collects
  nothing is not a pass.

# Run configuration (v2 plan)

## 1. Ports

| Use | Port |
| --- | --- |
| Live instance: **never contact** | 7717 |
| Sandbox servers (C-ISO) | 7800 to 7889 |
| Updater test server (C-UPD) | 7890 to 7899 |
| Playwright under the sandbox | the port `sandbox.mjs env` assigns |

## 2. Gate levels

A card names one level. Commands run from the repository root unless a card
says otherwise. Until P0.3 is APPROVED, only L0 and the non-launching part of
L1 may run.

| Level | When | Commands |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **L0** docs only | cards that change only Markdown | `npx prettier --check <changed files>`; `node scripts/check-no-external-urls.mjs` |
| **L1** targeted | every implementation card | `npm run lint`; `npm run typecheck`; `npm run build:shared`, then the card's named test files with `npx vitest run <paths>` from the repository root (the root `vitest.config.ts` defines the projects) |
| **L2** parent acceptance | every parent review card | everything in §3 |
| **L3** native or real model | cards and parent reviews that say so | the card's listed commands, all through `sandbox.mjs` |

## 3. The L2 suite

```sh
npm run lint
npm run typecheck
TZ=UTC npm test
TZ=America/Denver npm test
TZ=America/Mexico_City npm test
TZ=Australia/Sydney npm test
npm run build
node scripts/v2/sandbox.mjs env --port 7810 > /tmp/apunta-v2-e2e.env && . /tmp/apunta-v2-e2e.env && npm run e2e
npm run eval -- --fake --runs 1
```

After P0.2, each `TZ=` run prints its effective zone (a test asserts it), so
four runs really exercise four zones. After P0.3, the e2e line is the only
permitted way to run Playwright. After S3.2, add
`npm run eval -- --fake --runs 1 --corpus e2e/fixtures/eval-es/tuning`.
After P3.3, add `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` and
`cargo test` in `src-tauri/`.

## 4. Evidence

- Write detailed output to `docs/v2/evidence/<card-id>/`. Keep it sanitized:
  replace sandbox paths with `<sandbox>`, the home folder with `~`, and never
  include hostnames, usernames, keys, tokens or real names.
- Raw logs stay in the sandbox run folder and are never committed.
- Each command's evidence records: working directory, exact command, exit
  code, start and end time, and a short excerpt (failures in full, up to 200
  lines).
- Status words: criteria `NOT RUN`, `PASS`, `FAIL`, `BLOCKED`; cards
  `NOT STARTED`, `IN PROGRESS`, `SUBMITTED`, `APPROVED`,
  `CHANGES REQUESTED`, `BLOCKED`; instruction reviews `CLEAR`, `DEFECT`,
